TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd brings directly relevant government IT delivery experience for PITB’s district-level case management / workflow automation system, with demonstrated capacity to execute large, multi-year implementations under formal quality and information security management. We are SECP incorporated (Pvt. Ltd.) and established in 2012, exceeding the five-year registration requirement [CO-PROFILE]. We hold valid ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 certifications [CO-PROFILE], aligned to PITB’s expectations for governed delivery and protection of citizen data.

Our closest past performance to an ICMS-style web platform is enterprise application delivery for government, supported by secure infrastructure and operational readiness. Examples completed within the last five years include: (1) LMS Development for a Provincial Government, PKR 102M over 25 months (completed 2023) [CAP-046]; (2) Cloud Infrastructure for a Federal Government, PKR 108M over 33 months (completed 2025) [CAP-012]; and (3) Cybersecurity for a Provincial Government, PKR 178M over 23 months (completed 2021) [CAP-049]. Each evidences delivery at or above the PKR 50M scale threshold and in public-sector environments [CAP-046][CAP-012][CAP-049].

We also bring strong transactional and high-availability system experience through Mobile Banking deployments for Provincial Government clients, including PKR 121M over 23 months (completed 2020) [CAP-023] and PKR 41M over 19 months (completed 2024) [CAP-035].

Our library does not yet evidence Urdu/English bilingual UI delivery or a proven DR RTO ≤ 4 hours in the cited projects; we will address this in implementation through dedicated UX/localization resources and DR design/verification under our ISO 27001 controls [CO-PROFILE]. The mandatory requirement for two CISSP (or equivalent) certified professionals is also a current gap in our evidence set; we will fulfill it via pre-award hiring/partnering and submit credentials with the final team roster [CO-PROFILE].
